Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 98.84 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.478 is the latest retrieved weekly Nov 13 observation, not a live measure. The Chicago Fed calendar schedules a new NFCI release for today at 8:30 AM ET; the downloaded series had not yet included that observation at the cutoff.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • SOFR was 3.92% effective Nov 23; NFCI was -0.478 for the week ending Nov 13; MOVE 98.84 and the 10-year Treasury 4.91% are Nov 24 observations. These are not synchronized or live measures. The next scheduled NFCI is today at 8:30 AM ET for the week ending Nov 20.
  • Beige Book is scheduled today: the Board's date-specific calendar says 2:00 PM ET and the Chicago Fed calendar lists a general 3:00 PM ET release time. The Board time is displayed with this discrepancy. The December FOMC meeting is Dec 8-9; the Board calendar lists the meeting at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM on Dec 9. Minutes are scheduled Dec 30 at 2:00 PM.
  • Thanksgiving is Thursday, Nov 26. The Board calendar says its daily and weekly statistical releases scheduled that day move to Friday, Nov 27; selected verified Friday releases are shown above. No exchange-hours claim is made.
  • Energy: EIA petroleum follows its standard Wednesday 10:30 AM ET schedule; natural gas storage is explicitly holiday-adjusted to noon today. TreasuryDirect lists 4-week and 17-week bills and a 7-year note today; bid-close times are in the calendar.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date conflict: the New York Fed November calendar lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM without a period. The BEA schedule instead places Personal Income and Outlays for October on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM and November on Dec 23 at 8:30 AM. The Nov 25 entry is retained as a conflicting New York Fed listing, not as a BEA-confirmed PCE release; verify an official calendar correction.
  • Beige Book timing discrepancy: Board's date-specific calendar gives Nov 25 at 2:00 PM ET; Chicago Fed gives the date and general 3:00 PM ET release time. The date-specific Board time is used with caveat.
  • The Chicago Fed Labor Market Indicators (Advance) dated Nov 24 is elapsed at the cutoff and excluded. Other elapsed releases are excluded from both tables and future-date summaries. Event periods are not inferred when the source gives none.
  • BLS pages were not requested; CPI, PPI, Employment Situation and claims dates/times were checked on the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar as directed. Census reports New Residential Sales and Preliminary U.S. Imports for Consumption of Steel Products today; both are included. Selected rows are not an exhaustive inventory of every publisher event. Conference Board and some outside regional-source schedules were not independently fetched; where listed, the New York Fed date-specific calendar is cited.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November/December calendars and SOFR API; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars and H.4.1; BEA schedule; Census 2026 calendar; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI CSV; TreasuryDirect auctions API; U.S. Treasury yield CSV; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; Philadelphia Fed survey page. Quotes are single-source Yahoo Finance.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this was not a full headline-risk review. Material verified watches: funding/conditions, Treasury supply, holiday-adjusted energy reports, the Beige Book time discrepancy and the New York Fed/BEA PCE date conflict.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
SPY finished Tuesday down 0.49%, ES is lower overnight, while VIX is 26.36, MOVE is 98.84 and the 10-year is 4.91%. Volatility measures are below their recent peaks but remain inconsistent with a low-risk assumption. Today's GDP, durable goods, the disputed New York Fed PCE calendar listing, Treasury auctions, energy releases and Beige Book make event timing important; Thanksgiving may add liquidity sensitivity. Wait for price and rates to respond to verified releases; do not treat a single overnight quote as confirmation. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess a cautious/neutral view if ES and rates move decisively together after the data or auctions, or if volatility broadens rather than easing. Do not use unsupported price levels or targets. Refresh quotes and verify contract specifications and holiday-session liquidity before execution.
